c_season_usability: unchanged from v4: a confirmation season counts only if at least 85% of its D1 team-games pass the box gate, decided outcome-free from the audit's d1_team_games_box_pass_rate_by_season before the read. A D1 team-game is a team-game whose team carries a conference id in the box record, which is taken from the event source at fetch time. Seasons below 85% are dropped and listed on the card. Fewer than 3 usable seasons means CONFIRMATION_UNAVAILABLE (v4 rule).
d_coefficients: one OLS fit, no intercept, of the v4 P1 form on ALL development rows 2023-2026 together: target = margin - v7_mu (v7_mu exactly as v4's baseline_v7_mu), regressors dA = avail_top7_prev1(home) - avail_top7_prev1(away) and dL = top7_minutes_share_out_3plus(home) - top7_minutes_share_out_3plus(away), on cohort rows where all four inputs are non-null, inputs from the v4-pinned table. b1 and b2 are recorded on the confirmation card before any confirmation line or outcome is read, then applied unchanged: mu = v7_mu_confirmation + b1*dA + b2*dL, adjustment 0 when any input is null. v7_mu_confirmation is the served-constant v7 mean of the confirmation replay (replay_261120, as in confirmation_pin_a_ml_w0 arms.mu_v7_scale_v7), with v7's scale and dist. No refit on confirmation data.
